name: FA_ACE_BOOKS
description: FA_ACE_BOOKS contains financial information for your Adjusted Current Earnings (ACE) depreciation book. It is a temporary table in Oracle Fusion Assets. The Populate ACE interface process populates the data in this table. Oracle Fusion Assets first deletes any data in this table before running the process and then inserts into this table the financial information of assets you placed in service before 1981, MACRS assets placed in service before 1990, and ACRS assets. The program ignores assets that do not fit into one of these groups.  Oracle Fusion Assets uses the information in the table to update these assets in your ACE tax book when you run the Update ACE tax book process.

columns.name: MLC_UPDATE_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether or not the Adjusted Current Earnings (ACE) process needs to update the depreciation method, life, prorate convention, and rate adjustment factor with the values in this table.

columns.name: COST
columns.description: Total recorded cost of the asset.

columns.name: ADJUSTED_COST
columns.description: Depreciable basis of the asset, calculated as recoverable cost for cost basis depreciation methods, and recoverable cost less the accumulated depreciation for NBV basis methods.

columns.name: FLAT_RATE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the rates for the flat rate depreciation method.

columns.name: RATE_ADJUSTMENT_FACTOR
columns.description: Internal factor used to adjust depreciation rates to depreciate the net book value over the remaining life.

columns.name: DEPRN_RESERVE
columns.description: Total depreciation expense including the bonus depreciation recognized for the asset.

columns.name: PRODUCTION_CAPACITY
columns.description: Production capacity for assets that use units of production method.

columns.name: ADJUSTED_CAPACITY
columns.description: Remaining production capacity used to depreciate assets that use units of production method.

columns.name: LTD_PRODUCTION
columns.description: Life-to-date production for a units of production asset.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
